node.title: Use 'use' in foreach
node.author: zidi
node.doctext: Hey, I am currently storing some non core perl modules in an array like this: my @NotInstalledModules = ( 'Foo::Bar', 'Bar::Foo', ) And I am able to install these modules (install, if eval("use $_") not possible...). The only problem is that I can't 'use' them afterwards. I tried: foreach (@Dependencies){ use $_; } which is not working. Any help is appreciated Best regards
